name: String pad
why: Slow, soft chords that fade in and out behind everything else. They carry the mood while the drums carry the track.

ingredients.name: A sawtooth chord
ingredients.adds: One bright, flat chord per bar.

ingredients.name: Make it an ensemble
ingredients.adds: Three slightly detuned saws play each note, like a string section.
ingredients.listenFor: A gentle shimmer where there was a buzz.

ingredients.name: Fade in and out
ingredients.adds: Each chord swells up and trails away.
ingredients.listenFor: The hard start of each chord disappears.

knobs.above: The chord is over before it arrives.
Each chord is still ringing through the next.

ingredients.name: Darken it
ingredients.adds: Pushes the pad to the back.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: It sits on top of the lead.

ingredients.name: A big room
ingredients.adds: A long tail that joins the chords together.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.above: A fog with no chords in it.
